verdict.rationale: Godot is MIT-licensed open source (github.com/godotengine/godot, godotengine.org/license), explicitly allowing free use, modification, and redistribution of the engine source, with compilation instructions provided for all platforms and an active community contribution process for core engine changes. missing for 10: no direct hands-on evidence of a developer forking/modifying core C++ engine source in this pack, only docs/license claims and community remarks about contributing to core.
